decision: 5 second time penalty. 1 penalty point (total of 8 for the 12 month period). Reason The Stewards reviewed video, team radio and in-car video evidence and determined that Car 11 was released from a pit stop in an unsafe manner. Car 14 had to take evasive action to avoid a collision. What made the situation worse was the fact that Car 11 left the pits when there was a red light shown to it (indicating that it should not go out of the pit box). We therefore imposed a 5 second time penalty and 1 penalty point.
offence: Breach of Article 34.14 a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 11 Unsafe Release
